title: Eric Henry Wang, special projects at Wright-Patterson
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Eric Henry Wang, special projects at Wright-Patterson, about post-1945 at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: another guy named Eric Henry Wang who was um head of special projects at Wright Patterson.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a man named Eric Henry Wang, who he says was head of special projects at Wright-Patterson, a US Air Force base, in the years after 1945. Michels brings Wang up alongside the inventor Viktor Schauberger in a story about secret postwar research. If true, it would place Wang at the center of the military's most sensitive work in that era.
